limitations: Two exposed 16-second tracks on one GitHub host, one A/B pair per track with reversed order.
RTF below one would establish throughput for these host replays only; call tails and real-time scheduling remain separate.
No SSC305/BSP, microphone, word-end latency, independent FAR/FRR or formal model/data admission evidence.
Empty event sequences do not validate nonempty detection behavior; embeddings and all head outputs are still compared bitwise.
memory_scope: PSS/RSS are process observations including PCM preload, timing arrays, runner and code; -1 remains unavailable. Lifetime peak RSS is not isolated KWS memory.
quantile_scope: Per-track reported call p95/p99 checked for finite monotonic values; raw call arrays were not retained, so pooled quantiles were not reconstructed.
